parameters.description: Name of the property index to be created.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Adaptive script (expression-like; must return a value) used to calculate the index value(s). While evaluating, current::object, current::objectId, current::objectType, and current::key are available (issue #54). If omitted, the property named by key is indexed.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Object type id(s) this index may apply to.
parameters.name: objectType

parameters.description: Adaptive script that must return a boolean to decide whether this index applies to a particular object. Uses the same current:: variables as value (issue #54). If omitted, the filter is always true.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Retroactively generate indexes for existing objects.
parameters.name: retroactive

returns.description: Object response from the indexing process
